text:
maddie_marketing: Quick sync — want to run a compact PLG microexperiment tied to the "Briefcase" launch posts + workshop. Hypothesis: credits + contextual prompt pack will move first-successful-prompt and workshop RSVP. :briefcase:

maddie_marketing: Outline:
- 2.5k free credits reserved for briefcase workshop signups (auto-enroll)
- Deliver a 4-item prompt pack at signup (summarize, rewrite for audience, idea-spark, code-assist)
- 3 nudges across 7 days (day1 toast, day2 email, day5 office-hours invite)
- Arms: baseline / credits-only / credits+pack+nudges

leo_growth: routing q: how do we funnel inbound posts to the experiment? UTMs?

maddie_marketing: route via utm_campaign=briefcase and tag signup cohort=briefcase-pilot. auto-enroll first 2.5k or 21 days.

anya_product: primary metric = pct that runs prompt.execute(template_id) within 7 days. secondary = workshop RSVP and conversion to paid within 14d. success = +6pp on prompt success.

nina_analytics: can track. please ensure experiment_id and utm_campaign in events. quick power note: baseline ~17% => need ~1500/arm for +6pp; with 2.5k cap bias treatment arms 20/40/40.

sam_design: UX: first-login mini-modal with 2 quick examples per template + one-click Try. include opt-in: "share anonymized prompt usage to improve templates". i'll drop copy + 1-screen mock by tomorrow. :art:

leo_growth: creative for launch posts: two narratives — "bench-to-briefcase" (benchmark->business outcome) vs "quick-win" (ship feature fast). we'll tag creative_variant in UTMs.

maddie_marketing: routing follow-ups: if no template usage in 48h, queue gentle office-hours invite + short tips email. if heavy trial activity, surface to AE queue for human outreach.

eng_ops_bot: experiment created: exp.briefcase.5001234567 | cohorts: baseline/credits/full | allocation: 20/40/40 | tag=experiment_id=exp.briefcase.5001234567

nina_analytics: actionables I'll execute: event specs + dashboard + SQL cohorts (ETA Wed). add anonymized_use true/false.

maddie_marketing: action items:
- maddie_marketing: confirm credits budget + update brief (today)
- sam_design: modal + email copy + mock (tomorrow AM)
- anya_product: follow-up rule + AE routing (ETA Wed)
- leo_growth: creative assets + UTM matrix (EOD)
- nina_analytics: dashboard + power calc (ETA Wed)

leo_growth: will prep a short manual outreach script for top signups and a triage doc.

maddie_marketing: unless objections i'll flip switch next Tue. ping here for blockers. :seedling:
